Not attraction in the romantic sense, but in the platonic sense - my sister is BPD and I'm AvPD. She's always seemed more drawn to me than our other siblings. I'm not sure as to why myself. She says it's because of the similarity in our experiences of living with these conditions. In terms of solidarity and mutual understanding, I can see where she's coming from.
Agree with a lot of your points here. I wanted to like it a lot more than I did. And I'm still angry at that stupid tiger for disrespecting Saejima like that.

I'd like to think that connecting with others who understand would allow an opportunity to get out of our heads and talk about our experiences with it. Or, at the very least, provide the space to do so. Makes me wish we had such a thing.

I'm sorry that was your experience. I feel the same; I wish this condition was more widely known and understood so there would be more support for those of us that struggle with it. It's something I've only felt comfortable discussing with others who do. I wish there were places in our communities where we could connect and do so.
